title: Joining a conversation at a party
objectives: Show interest and ask what happened next
Ask how the other guest knows the host

courseTemplate.setting: Two guests wore the same shirt by chance and took a photo. The partner knows the host from school.

roles.learner: A guest joining a casual conversation
roles.partner: A guest telling a lighthearted story

courseTemplate.openingLine: He showed up wearing the exact same shirt as the host!

targetPatterns.pattern: No way! What did they do?

targetPatterns.pattern: That's great. How do you know the host, by the way?
targetPatterns.example: That's great. How do you know the host, by the way?

targetPatterns.pattern: We work together. I should get going, but it was nice chatting!
targetPatterns.example: We work together. I should get going, but it was nice chatting!

targetPatterns.pattern: Mind if I join you guys?

targetPatterns.pattern: So how do you all know each other?

targetPatterns.pattern: What are you drinking? Can I get you one?

targetPatterns.pattern: I'll grab another drink — chat later!
targetPatterns.example: I'll grab another drink — chat later!

targetPatterns.pattern: This party is great — who organized it?

targetPatterns.pattern: I should head out before the last train.

stages.title: Show interest and ask what happened next
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “He showed up wearing the exact same shirt as the host!”
successCriteria: The learner can show interest and ask what happened next in their own words.
hints: You can start with “No way! What did …”

stages.title: Ask how the other guest knows the host
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “They took a photo together, of course.”
successCriteria: The learner can ask how the other guest knows the host in their own words.
hints: You can start with “That's great. How do …”

stages.title: Close the conversation politely
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “We went to school together in Berlin. How about you?”
successCriteria: The learner can close the conversation politely in their own words.
hints: You can start with “We work together. I …”
